Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are present. Elevated urine glucose may suggest glycosuria. Low specific gravity could indicate dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
